violation_type.title: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Inspect Daily (26 TAC §746.4751(a))
violation_type.short_title: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Inspect Daily
violation_type.typical_finding: The documentation provided indicates that the center has not been completing its weekly and monthly maintenance outdoor checks.

finding_variants.text: The documentation provided indicates that the center has not been completing its weekly and monthly maintenance outdoor checks.
There are three ant piles on the operation's playground.
While conducting an inspection, the operation was not able to produce a daily playground check list.
Outdoor playground was inspected there were broken toys and trash bins accessible to the children.
One of the tunnels on the large play structure had water and mulch inside of it.  The staff did not inspect the play structure while conducting their morning playground check.

The toddler and preschool playground was observed to have water on the fixtures causing a hazard for the children playing on them. This was corrected at inspection when the caregiver wiped the fixtures down with a towell.

occurrences.finding: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Inspect Daily: When the active play space and equipment is inspected daily, hazards must be addressed before the children play outside each day. Evidence substantiates that children have been playing outside with hazards present. Broken and cracked toys were observed during the inspection. These were removed from the playground during the inspection. There are three poles sticking up out of the ground on the playground for the younger children where something used to be anchored. There is a loose fence board on the playground with the play structure. There is a fenced off area against the building off the deck that has a gap in it that a hand or foot could fit through.
